stories.title: Petrol at highest price since 2022 as inflation reaches 3.5%
stories.summary: Petrol and diesel are at their highest prices since 2022, pushing inflation to its highest rate since October 2025 ahead of Chancellor John Healey’s first Budget. stories.title: Replacement A494 River Dee Bridge put back to give new Welsh Government time to consider scheme

stories.title: Council tax revaluation delayed again as £80m support bill proves too costly
stories.summary: Council tax bands in Wales will stay based on 2003 property values for longer, after the Welsh Government paused plans for a revaluation.
